tools.name: analyze_data
tools.description: Runs a natural-language question through the Tableau Analytics Agent against a semantic model and returns the interpreted question, data used, results and a narrative summary.

target_entity_name_or_id.description: API name or Id of the target semantic model.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: Lists Tableau Next dashboards available to the user (metadata only).

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Gets details of one Tableau Next dashboard, including contained visualizations.

dashboardIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the dashboard.

tools.name: list_visualizations
tools.description: Lists visualizations (worksheets) available across Tableau Next (metadata only).

tools.name: get_visualization
tools.description: Gets details of one Tableau Next visualization: name, type, data source and configuration.

visualisationIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the visualization.

tools.name: list_semantic_models
tools.description: Lists semantic data models available to the user. Call this first to discover analytical topics.

tools.name: get_semantic_model
tools.description: Gets the full profile of one semantic model, including business preferences and configuration.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_data_objects
tools.description: Lists the data objects (entities) defined in a semantic model.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_relationships
tools.description: Lists relationships between data objects in a semantic model: from, to, join type and cardinality.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: get_semantic_model_logical_view
tools.description: Gets the structure of one logical view in a semantic model.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

logicalViewIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the logical view.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_measures
tools.description: Lists numeric measures for a data object in a semantic model.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

dataObjectIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the data object.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_dimensions
tools.description: Lists dimensions for a data object in a semantic model.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

dataObjectIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the data object.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_metrics
tools.description: Lists governed business metrics and KPIs defined in a semantic model.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: get_semantic_model_metric
tools.description: Gets the full definition of one metric or KPI: calculation, data source, thresholds and targets.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

metricIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the metric.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_calculated_dimensions
tools.description: Lists calculated dimensions in a semantic model with their expressions.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: list_semantic_model_calculated_measures
tools.description: Lists calculated measures in a semantic model with their formulas.

modelIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the semantic model.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists Tableau Next workspaces available to the user, or returns one workspace by Id.

workspaceIdOrApiName.description: If provided, returns only this workspace.

tools.name: list_workspace_assets
tools.description: Lists dashboards, visualizations and other assets in a workspace.

workspaceIdOrApiName.description: The Id or API name of the workspace.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Searches dashboards, visualizations and semantic models by keyword with an optional type filter.

type.description: Optional asset type filter, for example dashboard, visualization or semanticModel.
